verdict.rationale: The 01's own docs say its assistants can execute code, browse the web, manage files and control third-party software, so cross-app actions are a documented capability. Nothing shows multi-step tasks running end-to-end without user oversight, or any reliability. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous multi-step task chaining, reliability or error-recovery documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended cross-app completion.

support.subject: As a power user, a multi-step task that crosses several apps completes without me babysitting every step

citations.quote: Assistants powered by the 01 can execute code, browse the web, read and create files, control third-party software, and beyond.
It processes input, executes commands, generates responses, and manages core logic using Open Interpreter.
